title: Clock Divide by 2
constraints: `clk_out` toggles on every rising edge of `clk`, giving half the frequency with an exact 50 % duty cycle.
Synchronous reset holds `clk_out` at 0. The first rising edge after reset drives it to 1.
Exactly one flip-flop. `clk_out` must come straight from the flop output (no logic after it): logic on a generated clock creates glitches.
hints: Because the output comes straight from a flop, the divided clock is glitch-free.
In a real chip you'd hand this net to the clock tree tool (a `create_generated_clock` constraint).
